connectionError.need: keep your films and make their pictures, clips and sounds
connectionError.devHint: Development: `npm run dev` starts it, or run it yourself with `npm run server`, then retry.
connectionError.portTaken: Another program is using port {port}. Close it, then press {retry}.
connectionError.portOtherUser: Another person signed in to this computer has the app open, on port {port}. One copy runs at a time: they can quit theirs (its tray icon), then press {retry}.
connectionError.portReserved: Windows has reserved port {port} for another use (Hyper-V, WSL or Docker), so the app can't use it. Restarting the computer usually frees it; Troubleshooting in the help says how to keep it free.
connectionError.serverError: Its server stopped as it started: {error}

notFound.title: There's no page here
notFound.message: The address doesn't match any page of the app.

empty.title: No films yet
empty.message: Start a film from a story idea. Its AI plans the shots, and you can change anything it does.

fields.title: Title
fields.storyHint: A sentence, a page or a whole script. The AI plans the shots from it, and only from it.
fields.lookHint: How the film looks, in a few words — “moody 35mm film, overcast light”. Every picture of the film is painted with them.

delete.title: Delete this film?
delete.message: “{title}” and everything in it — its cards, shots, pictures, clips and sounds — will be deleted. This can't be undone.

film.gone: This film was deleted in another window.

voices.speakAllHint: Speaks every line that has a speaker and no voice yet, each in its speaker's voice (the voice on the character's card). Speak a line before its clip is made: the clip's mouth moves to that voice.
voices.staleHint: The line was changed after it was spoken: speak it again to hear the new words, then make the clip again.

empty.title: Nothing to cut yet
empty.message: The cut is the film's shots in order, each with its clip. Plan or add shots and make their clips on the Shots tab.

cut.total: {n} of {of} shots in the film · {s} s
cut.plays: Plays {s} s of its {of} s clip
cut.noClip: No clip yet — left out of the film
cut.toShots: Make it on the Shots tab

export.label: The exported film
export.hint: Joins every shot that has a clip, in order, with its trims, transitions, lines, music and effects, into one MP4 video.
export.needsClips: Make the shots' clips first — the film is joined from them.
export.done: The film is exported: {s} s, {n} shots
export.skipped: {n} shots without a clip were left out.
export.downloaded: The film is in your Downloads folder

sounds.heading: Music and sound effects
sounds.lede: Laid over the whole film from a start time, at a volume — the AI makes each one from your words. The shots' spoken lines are on the Shots tab.
sounds.musicPlaceholder: A slow, tense string swell under rain
sounds.effectDone: The sound effect is made: {s} s
sounds.none: No music or sound effects yet.

delete.title: Delete this sound?
delete.message: “{what}” is taken out of the film and deleted. This can't be undone.

frames.title: Shot {n}'s first frames
frames.paintAllHint: Paints first frames for every shot that has none — several each, checked, the best kept. A few minutes a shot on an 8 GB card.
frames.none: No first frames yet. Paint some: several are painted, checked, and the best one kept.

delete.title: Delete this first frame?
delete.message: The picture is deleted. If the shot used it, it takes its best other frame. This can't be undone.

clips.title: Shot {n}'s clip

modeHints.auto: One pass for up to 5 seconds, a long take past that; a shot whose line has a voice is drawn to it.
modeHints.one: The whole clip at the film's size in one pass: the sharpest, up to about 5 seconds on an 8 GB card.
modeHints.long: Made at half size, then sharpened to the film's size: up to 13 seconds.
modeHints.paths: Draw on the first frame where things should move — a car's route, a blade's arc, the camera's push — and the clip follows.
modeHints.guide: A video from a 3D tool (depth, pose or edges) leads the shapes and the motion; the first frame gives the look.

clips.noFrame: This shot has no first frame yet: the clip will be made from its words alone. Paint its first frames first for a clip that matches the film.
clips.makeAllHint: Makes a clip for every shot that has none, from its first frame — several minutes a clip on an 8 GB card.
clips.allFailed: {n} shots couldn't be made — open each to see why.

delete.title: Delete this clip?
delete.message: The clip is deleted. If the film used it, it takes the shot's newest other clip. This can't be undone.

paths.canvas: The first frame: click to add a point to the path
paths.hint: Each path is where one thing goes, from its first point to its last over the clip. A few points are enough; the path is smoothed between them.

shots.editedHint: You changed this shot by hand: planning carries changes around it, never into it.

empty.title: No shots yet
empty.message: The AI plans the shots from the story: how each is framed, what happens, who is in it and what they say. You can change any of it.
empty.noStory: Write the story first — the shots are planned from it. Or add shots by hand.

plan.hint: The AI reads the story, adds the cards it needs, then plans every shot — a few minutes on a local model.
plan.needsStory: Write the story first, on the Story tab.
plan.againMessage: The {n} shots it has now are replaced, with their first frames and clips. Your cards stay. This can't be undone.

carry.offer: You changed shot {n}. Carry the change into the later shots? The AI rewrites the ones it affects and leaves the ones you changed yourself.
carry.notePlaceholder: What changed, in your words — “there is no thermos now; Teo keeps the coat”
carry.none: No later shot needed a change

fields.cameraHint: How the camera moves — “static”, “slow push in”, “pan left”, “tracking beside her”.
fields.actionHint: One or two sentences. A card's look comes from its card, so there's no need to repeat it here.
fields.cards: Who and what is in it
fields.cardsHint: The cards whose pictures keep them the same in this shot.
fields.lineHint: The words spoken in the shot, if any.
fields.speaker: Spoken by

delete.title: Delete this shot?
delete.message: Shot {n}, with its first frames, clips and line, will be deleted. This can't be undone.

hints.character: Who is in the film. A character's picture keeps their face and clothes the same in every shot.
hints.place: Where the shots happen. A place's picture keeps the set the same.
hints.prop: Objects that matter to the story, kept the same wherever they appear.
hints.look: A style shown as a picture, for shots that should share it.

fields.name: Name

descriptionHint.character: How they look: age, build, hair, clothes — the picture is painted from these words.
descriptionHint.place: What the place looks like, its light and its time of day.
descriptionHint.prop: What the object looks like: its shape, colour and material.
descriptionHint.look: The style: the light, the colours, the film stock, the mood.

fields.voiceHint: How they sound — “a low, weathered woman's voice, calm and dry”. Their lines are spoken in it.

cards.pictureAfterAdd: Add the card first; then paint its picture or take one from a file.

delete.title: Delete this card?
delete.message: “{name}” and its picture will be deleted. Shots that use it keep their own pictures and clips. This can't be undone.

settings.title: Settings

general.filmsHint: A new film's picture size, as wide (its tall and square shapes follow). Every first frame and clip is painted at the film's size; both sides are steps of 64.
general.cardsHint: The long side a card's picture is painted at, and the largest picture file a card takes.
general.plannerHint: Plan the shots: the most shots a plan may have, the room the AI has for each answer with its thinking (a larger number lets a long story finish; a smaller one is quicker), and how fast a line is spoken — a shot with a line runs at least as long as it takes to say it.
general.windowsHint: The app open in more than one place at once — the desktop app, a browser on this server, a phone: how often each one looks for what the others changed. It shows their changes by itself.
general.checkSeconds: Look for other windows' changes every (seconds)
general.promptsTitle: The words pictures are painted from
general.promptsHint: Each kind of card's picture is painted from these words: {name} is the card's name, {description} its description and {look} the film's look. A shot's first frame is painted from {size} (its framing), {action} (what happens), {cards} (each of its cards' looks) and {look}; its clip from those and {camera} (the camera's move) and {line} (who says what).
general.clipsHint: The clips' frame rate (every clip tested was made at 24), and the largest guide video a shot takes.
general.framesHint: How many first frames a shot gets each time, how many of its cards' pictures go with them (who speaks first, then the other characters, the place, the props) and how small (smaller is faster and looks as good), and whether a vision model checks them and keeps the best.
general.frameCheck: Check them and keep the best
general.voicesHint: The lines are spoken by a voice design model: it makes a voice from words — the voice on the character's card, or the default voice below for a speaker without one. The model is downloaded on the AI page's Speech tab.
general.soundsHint: How long a piece of music or a sound effect is when you don't say, and the steps each is made in (more steps take longer; 8 is what was tested).

settings.appearanceHint: How the app looks — applied at once and kept by the app.
settings.backupsHint: A backup holds everything the app keeps: your films with their pictures, clips and sounds, your settings and your AI setup. Downloaded models aren't in it — they download again. Exported films aren't in it — they are made again from the clips.
settings.logsHint: What the server and this window reported, newest last.

about.blurb: A free AI film studio on your own computer: the AI plans the shots, paints the cast, sets and props, makes the clips with their voices, music and sound, and joins them into a film — and you can change any step.
